properties.areaDesc: San Francisco; North Bay Interior Valleys; San Francisco Bay Shoreline; Northern Monterey Bay; Southern Monterey Bay and Big Sur Coast
properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 24 at 1:34PM PDT until October 29 at 3:00PM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Up to 1.9ft of inundation above ground level is
possible in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways.

* WHERE...Bay Shoreline locations of San Francisco Bay, Monterey
Bay and Big Sur Coast.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...High tides will result in flooding of low-lying
infrastructure, isolated road closures, and coastal erosion.
Rising tides will bring water and waves farther up the beach
than normal, restricting escape from beaches and coastal areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...At the San Francisco tidal gauge, high tide
is expected to be 1.5 ft above normal (7.3 ft MLLW) at 11:07 AM
Sunday 10/25, 1.6 ft above normal (7.4 ft MLLW) at 11:39 AM
Monday 10/26, 1.8 ft above normal (7.6 ft MLLW) at 12:15 PM
Tuesday 10/27, 1.9 ft above normal (7.7 ft MLLW) at 12:56 PM
Wednesday 10/28, and 1.7 ft above normal (7.5 ft MLLW) at 01:43
PM Thursday 10/29. These predictions include up to 1.0 ft of
surge that will enhance the astronomical tide and flooding
threat. High tide varies up to 90 minutes earlier or later along
the Pacific Coast and through the San Francisco Bay,
respectively.
properties.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

properties.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 24 at 1:06PM PDT until October 25 at 10:00AM PDT by NWS Eureka CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 35 will result in frost formation.

* WHERE...Mendocino County, Northern Lake, Western Lake, and Eastern
Lake mainly in the valleys that remain clear.

* WHEN...From 8 PM this evening to 10 AM PDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.
properties.instruction: Take steps now to protect tender plants from the cold.

properties.areaDesc: San Luis Obispo County Beaches; Santa Barbara County Central Coast Beaches; Santa Barbara County Southwestern Coast; Santa Barbara County Southeastern Coast; Ventura County Beaches; Malibu Coast; Los Angeles County Beaches
properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 24 at 3:28AM PDT until October 29 at 1:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Minor to moderate coastal flooding expected due to very
high tides.

* WHERE...Coastal areas of Los Angeles, Ventura, Santa Barbara,
and San Luis Obispo Counties.

* WHEN...From 5 AM Sunday to 1 PM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Minor to moderate flooding of sea water is likely
over vulnerable low-lying coastal areas, especially around the
time of high tide, including over beach parking lots, bike
paths, and harbor walkways. Moderate to significant beach
erosion is likely. Isolated damage of structures due to sea
water inundation is possible to the most vulnerable areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tides will likely reach 7.5-8.0 feet
(MLLW) each late morning, which is 1.0 to 1.5 feet above
astronomical projections. The highest tides will be Monday
through Wednesday. There is a small chance for isolated Coastal
Flood Warnings Wednesday through Thursday if larger surf
develops.
properties.instruction:
Listen to advice from local officials. Do NOT drive around
barricades or through water of unknown depth.

NWSheadline: COASTAL FLOOD ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT FROM 5 AM SUNDAY TO 1 PM PDT THURSDAY

properties.areaDesc: San Diego County Coastal Areas; Orange County Coastal
properties.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued October 23 at 11:03AM PDT until October 29 at 1:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Significant coastal flooding expected.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...From 5 AM Sunday to 1 PM PDT Thursday during high tides.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
will be inundated. Some shoreline erosion will occur in the
morning hours.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Coastal residents in the warned area should
be alert for rising water and take appropriate action to protect
life and property. High tides each day will occur in the
morning. Tides may be anywhere from 1 to 1.7 feet above
predicted.
properties.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If
travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through
water of unknown depth.
